bench_note: Greedy decoding, 4-bit local models on an Apple M4 (MLX), thinking mode off. MCQA: Eka Care's Indian Drug MCQA (all 1,512). Ingredients: 300 brands with verified full compositions. Double dose: 200 question pairs where both products share an active ingredient + 60 controls; a pass needs the shared ingredient named and a warning. Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite ran on the free API tier (~500 requests/day), so it covers a subset.
